decisions.reason: The ERP interface plugin is central to multichannel integration and client lock-in, so it is worth maintaining even through platform migrations.
As the core price comparison tracking plugin, it supports the firm's measurable-marketing promise and should be the variant kept if the three are consolidated.
It overlaps with C, was not visible on the website in 2020–2021, and porting it to new shop platform versions is hard to justify.
The third tracking variant is the most redundant, and folding it into C frees developer time for new projects.
The companion net price display plugin was already withdrawn, which weakens the case for this reporting add-on, and it was not visible on the website in 2020–2021.
